Summaries.eng: The Barbapapas are a blob-like shape-shifting family consisting of the pink Barbapapa, the black Barbamama and their seven children. Throughout their adventures, they display family spirit and a great imagination to solve problems while taking care to protect the environment and the well-being of animals. Always in a fun and playful mood, the Barbapapa family values friendship, family spirit and non-violence.

Summaries.zho: 在一户普通人家的院子里，某天地下长出一个圆滚滚的粉红色小球。随着时间的推移，小球变得越来越大，最终他破土而出，长成椭圆形的大个子，孩子们为他起名叫巴巴爸爸。巴巴爸爸乐观善良，他柔软的身体可以随心所欲变换任何形状。不久，他遇见通体黑色、美丽动人的巴巴妈妈，两人结婚生下了七个颜色各异、性格不同的孩子，分别是巴巴祖、巴巴拉拉、巴巴利波、巴巴伯、巴巴贝尔、巴巴布莱特、巴巴布拉伯。巴巴爸爸一家和人类们和谐相处，过着充满快乐和惊奇的生活。

Summaries.eng: In the spring, a mysterious bud sprouts in Cindy and Frank's garden.
Barbapapa tours the city and encounters many dangers.
Barbapapa and his friends decide to explore the wonders of the sea by embarking on a submarine expedition.
Barbapapa feels lonely and his friends try to cheer him up, with no success. Barbapapa sets off to look for more Barbapapas with Cindy and Frank.
Barbapapa, Cindy and Frank are traveling. They sail across the sea and arrive in London, where they hope to find more Barbapapas.
Barbapapa is traveling in India with his friends. They meet a fakir and decide to ask him where they could find more Barbapapas.
Barbapapa, Cindy and Frank are still searching for Barbamama. Will they find her in America?
After many adventures, Barbapapa returns home and finally meets Barbamama. Upon spring seven adorable Barbababies are born.
The Barbafamily goes sailing, but a suddenly rising storm threatens to wreck the sailboat.
Barbapapa and Barbamama move to a beautiful old house with their children.
The Barbapapas are so happy with their new house. Unfortunately, construction workers show up and ask them to move out.
Oh, how cute the Barbapapas' house is! Each family member has a room. Help! The bulldozers are coming!

Summaries.zho: 巴巴爸爸家的七个孩子可不一般：巴巴伯是个小画家，巴巴贝尔喜欢表演，巴巴拉拉擅长演奏各种乐器，巴巴布莱特是个天才机械师... 巴巴祖认识所有的小动物，巴巴利波酷爱读书，是个小知识分子，最后还有巴巴布拉伯是个运动健将，他可厉害啦！他们的这些本领可在生活中派上了大用场，尤其是到关键时刻，每个宝贝各显神通，与爸爸妈妈一起度过难关。快来和巴巴爸爸一家一起去探险吧 ！
Summaries.ita: I sette figli della famiglia del padre di Barba non sono comuni: Babazu è un piccolo pittore, Bababel ama esibirsi, Barbara è brava a suonare vari strumenti musicali, Baba Bright è un meccanico geniale... Babazu conosce tutti gli animaletti e Babali Bo ama leggere ed è un piccolo intellettuale, e infine c'è Baba Brabo che è un atleta, è fantastico! Queste loro abilità possono tornare utili nella vita, soprattutto nel momento critico, ogni bambino mostra le proprie abilità speciali e supereranno le difficoltà insieme ai genitori. Vieni e parti per un'avventura con Barbapapà e la sua famiglia!
Summaries.fra: Les sept enfants de la famille du père de Barbapapa ne sont pas ordinaires : Barbouille est un petit peintre, Bababel adore jouer, Barbalala sait jouer de divers instruments de musique, Barbibul est un brillant mécanicien... Barbidou connaît tous les petits animaux et Barbotine adore lire et est un peu intellectuelle, et enfin il y a Barbidur qui est un athlète, il est fantastique ! Ces compétences peuvent s'avérer utiles dans la vie, en particulier au moment critique où chaque enfant montre ses propres capacités particulières et surmontera les difficultés avec ses parents. Venez partir à l'aventure avec Barbapapa et sa famille !

Titles.eng: The Secret of the Missing Pie
